articles.title: Trump’s Approval Hits New Low As Iran War Fuels Political Pressure | Watch
articles.description: Trump's approval rating is crashing as the Iran war reshapes American politics. A new Reuters/Ipsos poll shows Donald Trump's approval at just 33%, while 64% of Americans disapprove of his performance — tying the lowest point of his first term. With 80% of Americans expecting the Iran conflict to last for a long time, rising gasoline prices and growing concerns over the economic fallout are becoming a major political liability for the Trump administration. The poll also reveals a major shift on the economy, with Democrats now holding an edge over Republicans on handling economic issues and the cost of living. Meanwhile, the Republican advantage on immigration has narrowed dramatically.

articles.title: Iran Sets Conditions for Hormuz Reopening as Tensions With U.S. Remain High | Watch
articles.description: The Strait of Hormuz remains at the center of a growing standoff between Iran and the United States. Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf says the waterway will not reopen until Washington fulfills commitments Tehran says were agreed under an interim memorandum of understanding. Speaking in parliament, Ghalibaf said the conditions include lifting the naval blockade and oil sanctions, releasing Iran’s frozen assets, and ending threats and military operations against Iran. He also accused Washington of seeking to create economic pressure and divisions inside Iranian society. The remarks come as tensions remain high over Hormuz, a crucial global energy route.

articles.title: BREAKING: UAE Hit By 'Missile Threat', Iran Resumes Revenge Operation? Air Defences Scramble
articles.description: A fresh missile scare has gripped the UAE after its air defence systems detected a potential missile threat targeting the country. The UAE Defence Ministry urged residents to remain in safe locations and follow official warnings, while the Interior Ministry issued an emergency phone alert asking people to seek shelter in the nearest secure building. The warning reportedly came shortly after missiles were launched from Yemen, with reports linking the launches to the Houthis, though the exact target remains unclear. The alert is particularly significant as it is reportedly the first such warning in months, following a false alarm in June. With regional tensions still running high, the latest incident has once again raised fears of a wider missile threat from Yemen.

UKMTO says everyone aboard is accounted for and no environmental damage has been reported. No government or armed group has claimed responsibility, while authorities have warned vessels to exercise extreme caution amid the escalating US-Iran confrontation. Watch.

articles.title: Iran Launches Double Ballistic Missile Attack On UAE; U.S. Defences Tested?
articles.description: A major missile scare has erupted over the UAE, with the Defence Ministry saying two ballistic missiles were launched from Iran towards the country as US-Iran negotiations ended. UAE air defence systems detected both missiles. Officials said one fell outside the UAE’s territorial waters, while the second fell inside them. The development comes as tensions between Iran and the United States remain high, raising concerns over a possible escalation. Earlier, UAE authorities activated emergency warnings after detecting a potential missile threat. Residents were urged to stay in safe locations and follow official instructions.
